tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Background of the Full and Focused panels (UIPanelStyle.background, alpha 217 = 0.85). Every text pair below is checked on it. The framework's F4VR_PANEL_STYLE uses alpha 166 (0.65); at that value green text drops to 4.3:1 against a white sky.

tokens.name: glass-widget
tokens.usage: Exact F4VR_PANEL_STYLE / F4VR_BUTTON_STYLE background. Only for the vrui wrist buttons, whose large text needs 3:1.

tokens.name: popup
tokens.usage: ImGuiCol_PopupBg: dropdown lists and the confirmation dialog, nearly opaque so the rows under them do not show through.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: ImGuiCol_ModalWindowDimBg: dims the panel behind a confirmation dialog.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Green at 6%: the navigation pane and the Focused panel's help area, so they read as fixed regions.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Green at 10%: ImGuiCol_FrameBg. The empty part of a slider, a stepper's value box, the unselected half of a toggle.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Green at 12%: a row or control under the ray (ImGuiCol_HeaderHovered, ButtonHovered, FrameBgHovered). Always paired with a frame-border outline, because the tint alone is only 1.3:1.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Green at 20%: trigger held on a control (ImGuiCol_HeaderActive, ButtonActive, FrameBgActive). Paired with a glow outline.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Green at 40%: section rules and separators (ImGuiCol_Separator). Decorative, 2.7:1.

tokens.name: frame-border
tokens.usage: Green at 55%: ImGuiCol_Border. Outlines of controls, buttons and hovered rows. At least 3.7:1 on glass.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: The house color, rgb 10,250,120, from F4VR_PANEL_STYLE. All primary text (ImGuiCol_Text), the panel border, focus rings, the selected bar, the slider fill and grab. 9:1 on glass, 6.8:1 on hover, 5.6:1 on pressed.

tokens.name: green-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: help, page help, units, counts, the session status (ImGuiCol_TextDisabled). 8.3:1 on glass, 5.2:1 on pressed. Never for a value the player edits.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The pressed outline and the slider grab while dragging (ImGuiCol_SliderGrabActive). Close to the pointer mark color, so press feedback reads as coming from the ray.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and drawn icons on a solid green fill: the selected tree row, the selected half of a toggle, the current option, the Save button. 13:1.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Pending: a setting that differs from its saved value. The gutter dot, the value text and the unsaved count in the Save bar. Never alone: always with the dot. 7.7:1 on glass, 4.8:1 on pressed.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on an amber fill, if one is ever needed.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Invalid: the value text and the gutter mark of a setting that cannot be saved, and the error in the help line. Always with the drawn warning mark. 6:1 on glass and plate, 4.5:1 on hover; not on pressed.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: The "!" inside the drawn warning triangle, which is filled red. 8.9:1.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Text and outlines of a disabled row or control, which is ImGui's DisabledAlpha 0.4 applied to green. Exempt from contrast, as WCAG allows for disabled controls.

tokens.name: ray
tokens.usage: The pointer ray: cRayColor = { rgb = [190, 255, 190], alpha = 200 } in [Pointer] of ModsConfigVR.toml.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: The mark where the ray meets the panel: cMarkColor = { rgb = [215, 255, 215], alpha = 180 }.

tokens.name: mark-border
tokens.usage: The border of the mark: cMarkBorderColor = { rgb = [215, 255, 215], alpha = 100 }.

styles.name: t-title
styles.usage: ImGui size 26 px: PushFont(nullptr, FONT_SIZE_TITLE) around the call. The breadcrumbs in the title bar and a dialog title. ImGui sizes a font by its ascent minus descent, so 26 px is a 22.19 px em in CSS.

styles.name: t-body
styles.usage: ImGui size 21 px, the size the menu loads the font at (FONT_SIZE). Everything else: tree rows, setting names, values, buttons, descriptions. A 21 px line is about 1.2 degrees tall at the Full panel's default distance.

styles.name: t-detail
styles.usage: ImGui size 18 px: PushFont(nullptr, FONT_SIZE_DETAIL). Counts, units beside a value, and help that needs a third line. Never smaller: an 18 px line is about 1 degree at the Full panel's distance, and the framework clamps fonts at 16 px.

spacing.note: ImGui layout pixels at 1x. On a UIImGuiPanel, 48 px is one vrui unit.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: TouchExtraPadding on each side: widens hit boxes into the item gap without moving anything.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: ItemSpacing.y and ItemInnerSpacing: between rows, between a control's parts.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: FramePadding.y and ItemSpacing.x.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: FramePadding.x, WindowPadding of the content pane and of popups, the gap between the navigation and content panes, a level of the tree, as a page under its mod.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: The row gutter that holds the pending dot or the warning mark; space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: IndentSpacing: a level of the content, as a section in a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: One vrui unit. The smallest target the ray is asked to hit.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The Full panel's corner, cornerRadiusUnits 0.5 in ConfigMenu.cpp.

tokens.name: radius-widget
tokens.usage: F4VR_BUTTON_STYLE cornerRadiusUnits 0.2: the vrui wrist buttons.

tokens.name: radius-popup
tokens.usage: PopupRounding, ChildRounding, WindowRounding of the dialog.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: FrameRounding and ScrollbarRounding: controls, buttons, rows.

tokens.name: radius-grab
tokens.usage: GrabRounding: the slider grab.

size.note: Fixed sizes in ImGui layout pixels. The Full panel is 24 x 15 vrui units at 48 px a unit.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Full panel canvas width: PANEL_WIDTH 24 units. At PANEL_SCALE 6 it is 144 game units, about 2 m, curved at radius 25.

tokens.name: panel-height
tokens.usage: Full panel canvas height: PANEL_HEIGHT 15 units.

tokens.name: panel-padding
tokens.usage: UIPadding::all(0.3) in ConfigMenu.cpp: the canvas inset inside the Full panel's border.

tokens.name: focused-width
tokens.usage: Focused panel canvas, 12 units. Proposed; at scale 1.6 and about 45 cm from the eyes its text is the same angular size as on the Full panel.

tokens.name: focused-height
tokens.usage: Focused panel canvas, 9 units. Proposed.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Every pressable control and row, drawn at this height: not ImGui's frame height.

tokens.name: row-pitch
tokens.usage: Control height plus ItemSpacing.y: the distance from one setting row to the next.

tokens.name: titlebar-height
tokens.usage: The Full panel's title bar.

tokens.name: footer-height
tokens.usage: The footer: Discard and Save on the right; on the left the help line (two t-body lines or three t-detail lines) or the session status.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: The navigation tree (7 units): the same place and width with or without a selected mod.

tokens.name: description-height
tokens.usage: The Focused panel's help area: two t-body lines and space-2 above and below. The Full panel has none: its help is the left of the footer.

tokens.name: control-width
tokens.usage: The right-hand control column of a setting row. Its parts keep fixed widths so controls line up down the page.

tokens.name: value-width
tokens.usage: The value box of a slider or stepper: room for -1000.00 in t-body.

tokens.name: grab-width
tokens.usage: GrabMinSize: the slider grab, 20 x 40.

tokens.name: scrollbar-size
tokens.usage: ScrollbarSize. A position indicator: lists scroll with the thumbstick.

tokens.name: border-panel
tokens.usage: The Full panel's edge: borderThicknessUnits 0.08 in ConfigMenu.cpp, in green.

tokens.name: border-frame
tokens.usage: FrameBorderSize, PopupBorderSize, SeparatorTextBorderSize, the hover outline and the focus ring.

tokens.name: border-widget
tokens.usage: F4VR_BUTTON_STYLE borderThicknessUnits 0.05 on the wrist buttons.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: ImGuiStyle.DisabledAlpha, applied by BeginDisabled to a whole row.

tokens.name: opacity-other-ray
tokens.usage: The ray of the hand that does not own the pointer, drawn by the framework with no mark.
